This role exists to build right-sized security programs that scale with Legora, strengthening office security, travel risk, executive protection, and incident readiness without losing the welcoming, open culture we want employees and guests to feel. You'll work across Workplace, People, IT, Security, Legal, Compliance, Comms, business leaders, vendors, and building partners, balancing hands-on operations with repeatable program design. Travel to Legora offices, events, and other locations is expected up to 30% based on operational needs. WHAT YOU'LL DO Corporate Security, Executive Protection & Event Security - Own security operations across Legora's offices, including access control, visitor management, badging, surveillance, guard services, emergency procedures, and facility protection, with baseline standards adapted to each site's local context and risk. - Build and run risk-based executive protection for the CEO and other senior leaders, including protective intelligence, travel risk, ground transportation, advance planning, residential considerations when appropriate, and protection scaled to actual threat and exposure. - Partner with Legal and Compliance to align security and safety programs with applicable requirements and company policies, involving them in relevant decisions, risks and incidents. - Manage security vendors and integrators, including contracts, pricing reviews, staffing models, service quality, and performance, as well as CCTV and alarm maintenance and infrastructure projects. - Own the security budget and forecast, including OPEX and CAPEX, aligning spend to Legora's risk and business priorities. Travel Security & Duty of Care - Build and run Legora's travel risk program, including pre-trip risk guidance, traveler tracking, destination briefings, and added support for higher-risk travel. - Own Legora's duty of care approach, making sure employees know what support exists, how to reach it, and what happens when something goes wrong while they're traveling. - Select and manage travel risk, medical, and security assistance providers, keeping coverage matched to where our people actually

Correctness is non-negotiable, and every bug has a number attached to it. - Design and ship event-driven services end to end: APIs, reconciliation pipelines, queues and more. - Write idempotent, resumable sync logic against third-party SaaS APIs you don’t control, handling partial failures, retries, out-of-order events and concurrency. - Work in Python and Azure, with infrastructure as code in TypeScript (Pulumi). - Own the deployment path: GitHub Actions CI/CD across dev, test and prod with gated environments, plus the observability that goes with it. - Write the tests that make the system safe to change, including unit and contract tests against recorded fixtures. - Work directly with Finance and RevOps to turn billing and revenue requirements into systems they trust, and debug with them when reality disagrees with the data. - Contribute to architecture decisions as the integration surface grows (new systems, entities and flows) without turning the codebase into a pile of special cases. WHO YOU ARE - You have 3+ years of experience building and operating backend systems in production, not just shipping features into one. - You’re strong in Python, and comfortable enough in TypeScript to own infrastructure code (or keen to learn). - You have hands-on experience integrating with REST APIs from SaaS applications, and you’ve moved and transformed data between them. You know what idempotency, retries, eventual consistency and reconciliation mean in practice. - You have experience with a cloud platform, ideally Azure (AWS or GCP translates fine), and with infrastructure as code. - You’re genuinely interested in how a business makes and books money. Experience with financial systems (billing, revenue, ERP) is a plus. - You’re proactive, self-directed and hungry. You take ownership of a system and thrive with a lot of autonomy in a fast-moving, high-growth company.
